title: Reusable Odoo Navigation and Productivity Customizations
objective: Provide installable, tested Odoo customizations that improve navigation and productivity across all customer deployments.

known_capabilities.title: Right-click context menu
known_capabilities.description: Provide a reusable right-click context menu framework and supported actions across appropriate Odoo views.

known_capabilities.title: Go to main table
known_capabilities.description: Provide consistent navigation from related or secondary views back to the authoritative main table.

candidate_capabilities.title: Additional reusable navigation shortcuts
candidate_capabilities.description: Identify and prioritize other navigation shortcuts that are useful across customer installations.

candidate_capabilities.title: List and form view productivity enhancements
candidate_capabilities.description: Evaluate consistent cross-module interaction improvements for list and form views.

candidate_capabilities.title: Shared cross-module interaction patterns
candidate_capabilities.description: Define reusable interaction conventions so future shared customizations behave consistently.

out_of_scope: Customer-specific business logic or one-off workflows
Changes to Odoo core source code
Features that cannot be supported across the declared Odoo compatibility target

architecture: Implement shared behavior as installable Odoo addon modules under customer-odoo/addons/.
Use reusable JavaScript and server-side extension contracts rather than customer-specific integrations.
Keep the product repository buildable, testable, and deployable without the development factory.
Require backward-compatible installation and upgrade behavior for every shared release.

proposed_work_packages.title: Discover and define the shared interaction model
proposed_work_packages.description: Confirm the supported Odoo views, interaction contracts, compatibility target, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlog of reusable capabilities.
proposed_work_packages.notes: Produces or refines the approved requirement revisions needed by implementation packages.

proposed_work_packages.title: Implement context-menu foundation
proposed_work_packages.description: Implement the right-click context menu capability with unit, browser, and upgrade coverage.

proposed_work_packages.title: Implement go-to-main-table functionality
proposed_work_packages.description: Implement authoritative-table navigation with unit, browser, and upgrade coverage.

proposed_work_packages.title: Harden and prepare the shared release
proposed_work_packages.description: Run cross-module compatibility checks, clean-install and production-snapshot upgrade rehearsals, and consolidate release evidence.

dependencies.description: Confirm the Odoo version supported by the product and shared customizations.
Confirm the supported browser matrix for browser-level acceptance tests.
Review existing product architecture and module boundaries before implementation.

risks.description: Odoo web-client internals may change across supported versions.
risks.mitigation: Confirm the version target early, isolate web-client extensions, and require browser and upgrade tests.

risks.description: Customer-installed addons may override or conflict with shared UI behavior.
risks.mitigation: Define extension points, document compatibility expectations, and test representative addon combinations.

risks.description: The set of desired shared productivity customizations is not yet complete.
risks.mitigation: Keep unknown capabilities in the candidate backlog and add them through new requirement revisions.

assumptions: The customizations are intended for the reusable customer-odoo product repository and may be deployed to multiple customer installations.
Each capability will receive explicit acceptance criteria before implementation.
Approved requirements, work packages, run plans, approvals, and release evidence remain in customer-odoo-delivery.

release_strategy.approach: Deliver the first two known capabilities as a shared foundation release, then add newly discovered capabilities through later requirement revisions and plan revisions.

increments.description: Initial reusable navigation foundation containing the context-menu and go-to-main-table capabilities.
